callouts.html: Billing through 2026-06-30. Calendar H1 is €3.31m vs €3.01m (+10.1%). Commercial in that window is -2.1%. Credit notes are not sales.
Q1 billing is -9.8% (€1.65m vs €1.83m). H1 is milder at +10.1% — later months recovered some of the hole. There is no official sales cut on file for this distributor.
Warranty is 52.3% of calendar 2025 (40.1% in 2023). Commercial over two years is -6.2%.
July this year is not in the billing file yet, so July cannot be split. Do not read an official July miss from this pack.

aim.note: Catalogue family is PR00 group on the parts catalogue. 99.9% of Calendar 2025 commercial euros have a family name. The clustered bars name families from the selected window (at least €4,000 in either year, or 3% of the window). Other is unclassified plus families below that cut — not every classified euro. No Shell lubricant lines in this book, so Shell is not on the chart. On Calendar 2025 with warranty hidden, Other is 4,627 € (0%): Unclassified €3,243, Belts €1,384.
